description: This file defines the class MDB2_Extended, which adds high-level database methods to MDB2, including query building, execution, and ID retrieval, as well as constants for query types.

classes.name: MDB2_Extended
classes.description: A class extending MDB2 with additional high-level database operation methods.

methods.name: autoPrepare
methods.description: Generates and prepares an insert, update, delete, or select SQL statement.

methods.name: autoExecute
methods.description: Generates, prepares, and executes an insert, update, delete, or select SQL statement.

methods.name: buildManipSQL
methods.description: Constructs SQL statements for insert, update, delete, or select based on parameters.

methods.name: limitQuery
methods.description: Executes a query with limit and offset.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Fetches the first column of the first row from a query.

methods.name: getRow
methods.description: Fetches the first row from a query.

methods.name: getCol
methods.description: Fetches a single column from a result set.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches all rows from a query.

methods.name: getAssoc
methods.description: Fetches the result set as an associative array keyed by the first column.

methods.name: executeMultiple
methods.description: Executes multiple execute() calls on the same statement handle.

methods.name: getBeforeID
methods.description: Returns the next free ID of a sequence if auto-increment is not supported.

methods.name: getAfterID
methods.description: Returns the auto-increment ID or a provided ID after insertion.
